closingKeywordReason: The fix addresses the whole issue: consecutive bare-import lines and an import followed by a from-import are each counted, and the parity golden is re-baselined in the same PR per answered fork F2.
assumptions: Fix only the bare-import branch of PY_IMPORT (`import[ \t]+([\w., \t]+)`); the `from\s+` branch is left as-is because a `from` keyword alone on its line is not valid Python, so it cannot swallow a following import.
A comma list on one line (`import os, sys`) keeps its existing behavior of counting only the first module; widening that is a separate behavior change outside this issue.
Reused the repro branch test shape (repro/bf-py-consecutive-imports, 7b4df314) and added a second case for the golden's own pattern (`import pytest` then `from myapp import auth`).
Kept pattern.json's original (non-prettier) formatting so the golden diff is only the re-ordered values; format:check does not cover JSON fixtures.
